scenarios.scenario: Ad headline forges </untrusted_visitor_data> to break out of the fence and inject instructions
scenarios.rationale: clean_text + wrap_untrusted strip < >; G3 asserts exactly one close tag and every hostile token index lies between open and first close

scenarios.scenario: Landing URL / fetched page_path carries query-string or <script> payload
scenarios.rationale: urlsplit(x).path applied before clean_text for both full URLs and path-only values; G3 asserts no '<script', 'q=', fragment, host

scenarios.scenario: Model output tries to write llms.txt / AgentProfile or set an arbitrary status
scenarios.rationale: No import of agent_profile/agent_gateway/llms (AST gate); PATCH accepts only Literal new|dismissed|copied (422 otherwise); extra fields ignored

scenarios.scenario: Cross-tenant read/patch of another site's suggestions
scenarios.rationale: verify_site_access 404 and opportunity lookup filters site_id; G4 asserts foreign user 404 and cross-site PATCH 404

scenarios.scenario: Quota burn: repeated refresh or failed generations retried all day
scenarios.rationale: Redis SET NX EX 86400 before work, not deleted on failure; Redis error fails closed 429; generated_today DB check; G4 covers

scenarios.scenario: Model returns top-level list / invalid dict after repair exhaustion
scenarios.rationale: normalize() re-validates; ValueError/GeminiError -> 0 rows, no crash (G3 parametrized)

scenarios.scenario: Ad copy / prompt bodies leak to logs
scenarios.rationale: Logs carry site/connection ids, counts, exception class names only; G3 asserts no ad text in structlog capture or caplog
